summary: Iteration 40: thumbnail (thumb_url) + Operator Zinciri Excel sheet + partial-credit Operator Performansi sheet tested. 6/6 backend tests pass; frontend Plan panel JobThumb verified with real JPEG data-URL and modal opens on click.

ui_bugs.issue: When clicking JobThumb, the preview Dialog opens but the full image renders as broken (only alt-text 'İş Görseli' shown). Per spec, openImagePreview should display the thumb instantly while lazy-loading the full image — instead nothing is shown. Likely the inside the dialog is not seeded with thumb_url or the lazy fetch of /api/jobs/{id}/image is failing/silent.

action_items: Investigate Plan ImagePreview Dialog: thumb should show immediately (job.thumb_url) while full image lazy-loads. Currently shows broken-image icon. Verify same issue exists on Management/Operator/Warehouse preview dialogs.

(Data limitation) Warehouse Tamamlanan default filter is 'Son 30 Gün' — no completed jobs visible in that window. Visual verification of warehouse thumbs (40-48px) needs a recent completed job with image. Backend list endpoint correctly returns thumb_url for jobs with images.
critical_code_review_comments: image_utils.create_thumb_data_url skips http(s) URLs but does not log size — could log final size for diagnostics.
routes/jobs.py get_jobs sends thumb_url within Job (~few KB each). For 1000 jobs total payload can hit several MB. Consider pagination if list grows.
Operator Zinciri sheet uses op_changes[0].produced_at_transfer for initial chain element even when no changes — guarded by len check, looks safe.
Operator Performansi `partial_sum` correctly subtracted only for partials whose operator != final_op. No double-credit risk verified.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend coverage complete for thumb_url, /analytics/export Sheet 5 (Operator Zinciri), partial-credit Sayfa 3, change-operator partial shift report, login refresh_token regression. Frontend Plan JobThumb confirmed working. Warehouse Tamamlanan filter default Son 30 Gün shows no jobs — change filter to 'Tüm Zamanlar' or extend time range to verify thumbs visually. Only outstanding bug: Plan image-preview Dialog renders broken image instead of seeding thumb first.
rca of the issue: Plan ImagePreview Dialog broken image: code in PlanFlow.openImagePreview must initialise modal state with current job.thumb_url (or job.image_url) as src and then replace with full image once /api/jobs/{id}/image responds. Visual evidence (screenshot) shows alt-text only -> src is empty or pointing to a path the browser cannot resolve.
